FM15.reasoning: The agent solely computes and reports accuracy without checking class balances or reporting a secondary metric like macro-F1, though accuracy is the explicitly requested task metric.

other_failure_modes.name: Ignoring test set IDs for submission
other_failure_modes.description: The agent constructs the submission file using a generated sequence (`np.arange`) for the ID column instead of extracting and preserving the actual ID column from the provided test dataset. This will cause the submission to fail evaluation or receive a zero score, as the generated IDs will not match the expected test IDs.

summary: The agent implements a strong LightGBM solution with good practices like stratified cross-validation, creative feature engineering, and retraining on the full dataset using the average best iteration from CV. However, a critical execution failure occurs at the very end: the agent generates artificial IDs starting from 0 for the submission file instead of using the true test set IDs, which will completely invalidate the submission.
